name: gizza-ai/structured-data-validator
summary: Validate JSON-LD, microdata and RDFa structured data in HTML.

tool.description: Extract and validate structured data (JSON-LD, microdata, and RDFa) from pasted HTML. Lists every schema.org entity it finds with its @type and properties, and flags common mistakes: invalid JSON-LD, a missing or non-schema.org @context, objects with no @type, itemprop attributes outside any itemscope, an itemscope with no itemtype, and a typeof with no vocab. Set format='report' (default, human-readable) or 'json' (a machine-readable {counts, items, issues, valid} summary).

html.description: The HTML source to scan for structured data (paste the <head> and <body>).
